name: Spectral Wave
image_style: Cinematic retro-futurist comic illustration with crisp cel-shaded forms, subtle halftone grain, luminous spectral waves, and restrained 1970s space-adventure design. Mood: solemn, uncanny, affectionate, and quietly humorous, balancing heroic seriousness with an unmistakably out-of-place visitor. Use deep navy, midnight teal, parchment ivory, muted gold, and restrained crimson; preserve a spacious, low-detail upper edge and a calm widget-friendly region. Landscape composition, no lettering, logos, watermarks, frames, or interface elements.
scene: A 16:10 landscape view inside a vast medieval stone observatory-cockpit built into a Crusader-era castle tower, rendered with reverence and historical care: vaulted masonry, brass astronomical instruments, timber beams, worn parchment charts without readable marks, and a narrow arched opening toward a moonlit sea. A spectral turquoise wave rolls across the night horizon outside, illuminating the chamber. Space Ghost stands at the controls as a recognizable animated superhero in a muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, rigidly operating an antique astrolabe with complete professional seriousness. His cape catches the ghostly wind while a small brass compass trembles beside him. The humor comes only from his respectful, intensely focused presence in a setting where he plainly does not belong. Keep the top edge quiet and spacious, with no sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, lettering, or text.
